Name: NPCsWedding
Author: ElenionW
Description:
[center][size=5][font=Arial Black]Description [/font][/size]
This mod aims to enhance player immersion.
NPC Auto Marriage System
Once the player is married, the villagers are allowed to marry each other too. The mod features 6 fixed pairings: Penny×Sam, Abigail×Sebastian, Emily×Shane, Leah×Elliott, Maru×Harvey, and Haley×Alex. Every day the system rolls a chance (1/28 by default) to start a romance; once confirmed, the wedding takes place 3 days later with an early notice to the player. The mod adds 4 exclusive NPC wedding venues, each tailored to the couple's personality. On the big day, a full ceremony unfolds: Mayor Lewis officiates, the couple exchanges vows, the crowd cheers, and the bride and groom change into a wedding dress and tuxedo, kissing under the arch as everyone celebrates. After the wedding, married NPCs no longer show as "single" in the social panel, their friendship cap rises to 10 hearts, and the couple moves in together at the better-off partner's home.

Introduction Letter System (Player Matchmaking)
The general store sells introduction letters. Use one to introduce an NPC to another so they begin dating. Giving gifts to the introduced NPCs during the process simultaneously raises the chance of success. When the introduced couple officially marries, the player receives a precious gift matching the couple as a reward for playing matchmaker.

Door Visit Events
Newlywed NPC couples will visit the player in person, chat at the doorstep, and verbally invite you to their wedding.

Wedding Invitation Letters
Before the wedding, the player receives a letter of invitation from the couple. [/center]
[center][/center]
[center]NPC Pet System Beta[/center]
[center] 13 physical mini-pets live at home in town and follow their owners when they go out. Each pet has its own look, walking and idle animations.

NPC Gathering System
On the 14th of every month, a youth gathering takes place: 12 NPCs leave their homes and follow unique routes to the gathering spot with exclusive dialogue. On Winter 28, the year-end party brings 29 Stardew Valley villagers together to welcome the new year. [/center]
[center][/center]
[center]Match System[/center]
[center]If the player hasn't married by year 2,an NPC who has social ties with the marriage candidate that the player has the highest friendship with will visit the player and introduce that candidate to them.[/center]
[center][/center]
[center]1.1
A New Unique NPC
The Shroud Guider has joined the game. For now, it appears only as a functional NPC and takes no part in social life. Its abilities will keep expanding. [/center]
[center][/center]
[center]1.2[/center]
[center]NPC Relationship Web[/center]
[center]Open any NPC's profile from the social tab to see their relationship tiers with everyone in town (Hated / Acquaintance / Friendly / Close Friend / Beloved). Tiers are grouped for easy viewing, with mouse-wheel scrolling and a scroll bar. The player is also included in the appropriate tier based on heart level with that NPC.[/center]
[center]
More Relationship Event
35 dateable pairings (6 official couples + 29 non-couples) feature 99 exclusive story events in total.[/center]
[center][/center]
[center]Introduction Letter System Improvements
Introduction success chance now depends on the NPCs' relationship tier. Checks run every 7 days over a 21-day window; gifting a loved item raises the success chance, while a hated gift lowers it. The two introduced NPCs immediately become undateable by the player, and recover once the match fails.[/center]
[center][/center]
[center]Gift & Marriage Mechanics
NPC auto-marriages now require the player to be married and the two NPCs to be Friendly or above. After any wedding, the couple is automatically raised to the Beloved tier. If the player gifts a loved item to NPC A and then to NPC B on the same day, there is a 20% chance to raise A–B's relationship tier; gifting hated items to both has a 20% chance to lower it.

Greeting System
NPCs within 5 tiles interact according to their relationship: couples exchange hearts, Beloveds exchange happy emotes and greet each other, Close Friends exchange happy emotes, Friendly NPCs exchange formal greetings, and Hated pairs glare at each other. Once per pair per day. The player's spouse sends them a heart when nearby.[/center]
[center][/center]

[center][size=5][font=Arial Black]Installation instructions[/font][/size][/center]
Make sure you have SMAPI 4.0.0 or later installed. On first launch, the mod generates a config.json file, which you can adjust at any time.in-game via the Generic Mod Config Menu.

[center][size=5][font=Impact]Main features [/font][/size]
The heart of the mod is a fully autonomous NPC marriage system: once you are married, NPCs can date (through matchmaking), marry, and hold complete wedding ceremonies. You can also play matchmaker with introduction letters and earn precious gifts in return. Newlyweds visit your doorstep, invitation letters arrive before the ceremony, and post-wedding dialogues follow. On top of that, 13 mini-pets accompany NPCs around town, and two large gatherings take place on the 14th of each month and on Winter 28. The calendar marks wedding dates, the social panel updates marital status in real time, and every feature can be toggled in the config menu.

[size=5][font=Impact] Requirements [/font][/size]
This mod requires Stardew Valley 1.6 or later and SMAPI 4.0.0 or later.  Content Patcher and Generic Mod Config Menu must be installed to adjust settings in-game. Note that the mod MarketTown may cause issues.

[size=5][font=Impact]Shout outs[/font][/size]
Thanks to DeepSeekV4, GPT3.5, Claudefable5, and GLM5.2 for fulfilling my imagination. Thanks to stardewvalleywiki and stardewmodding.wiki for the detailed references on the vanilla event mechanics. And thanks to ConcernedApe for creating the warm, wonderful world of Stardew Valley.

[/center]
[center][font=Comic Sans MS]
[size=6]介绍[/size][/font][/center]

[center]这个 mod 旨在增强玩家沉浸感。
[/center]
[center]NPC 自动婚姻系统
玩家结婚后，镇上的 NPC 也被允许互相结婚。游戏内共有 6 对固定配对： Penny×Sam、Abigail×Sebastian、Emily×Shane、Leah×Elliott、Maru×Harvey、 Haley×Alex。系统每天按概率判定是否促成一段婚姻，默认概率 1/28；一旦 确定，婚礼将在 3 天后举行，并提前向玩家预告。 模组新增 4 个专属 NPC 婚礼场地，每对新人都有符合角色气质的仪式现场。 婚礼当天会播放完整的婚礼仪式——牧师刘易斯主持，新人宣读誓词，观众欢呼 庆祝；新人换上婚纱与燕尾服，在拱门下亲吻，接受全场的祝福。婚后，已婚 NPC 的社交面板不再显示"单身"，好感度上限提升至 10 心，且已婚 NPC 会 住进家境更好的一方的家中。

介绍信系统（玩家牵线）
杂货店出售介绍信。玩家可以将一位 NPC 介绍给另一位 NPC，让他们开始谈 恋爱。在介绍过程中，向被介绍的 NPC 同时赠送礼物，可以提高恋爱成功率。当 被介绍的 NPC 正式结婚时，玩家会收到与这对新人相匹配的珍贵礼物，作为 牵线成功的回报。

门访事件
新婚 NPC 夫妇会亲自上门拜访玩家，站在家门口与玩家寒暄交谈，并口头 邀请玩家参加他们的婚礼。 婚礼邀请函 婚礼前，玩家会收到一对新人寄来的信件邀请。 [/center]
[center][/center]
[center]NPC 宠物系统 测试中[/center]
[center]镇上有 13 只待在家中的实体迷你宠物，它们会跟随各自的主人出门逛街。 每只宠物都有独立的外观与行走、待机动画，各有各的小脾气。

特别聚会系统
每月 14 日举办青年聚会，12 名 NPC 会在当天走出家门，按独特的行动 路线前往聚会地点，并配有专属对话。冬 28 日举办年终聚会，29 名星露谷 NPC 齐聚一堂，迎接新年的到来。[/center]
[center][/center]
[center]介绍系统[/center]
[center]假如玩家第二年还没有结婚,与与玩家友谊最高的可婚NPC存在社交的NPC会拜访玩家并将其介绍给玩家.

1.1 [/center]
[center]新的独特 NPC
虚境导师现在加入了游戏。它暂时只能作为功能性 NPC 出现，不参与社交。 它的功能会逐步拓展。[/center]
[center][/center]
[center]1.2 [/center]
[center]NPC关系网[/center]
[center]社交面板点击任意 NPC 打开档案，可查看该 NPC 与全镇其他人的好感度档位（厌恶 / 认识 / 友好 / 密友 / 挚爱·挚友），按档位分组显示、支持滚轮滚动与滚动条。玩家自己也会按与该 NPC 的心数计入对应档位。[/center]
[center]
更多NPC关系事件
35 对可婚 NPC（6 对官配 + 29 对非官配）共 99 个专属剧情事件.[/center]
[center]
介绍信系统改进
介绍成功率现在与NPC好感度档位有关，每 7 天判定一次、21 天期限；同时送最爱礼物增加介绍成功率,讨厌礼物减少。被介绍的两位 NPC 立即进入不可婚状态，介绍失败后恢复。[/center]
[center][/center]
[center][/center]
[center]1.21[/center]
[center]修复了异常宠物导致的可能的卡顿问题[/center]
[center][/center]
[center]送礼机制改善
NPC 自动婚礼新增条件：玩家已婚且两位 NPC 关系 ≥ 友好。婚礼结束后结婚双方自动提升为挚爱档。玩家同一天给 A 送最爱再给 B 送最爱，有 20% 概率提升 A-B 关系档位；都送厌恶则 20% 概率降低。[/center]
[center]
打招呼机制[/center]
[center]不同关系的 NPC 相遇（5 格内）会互动：伴侣互发爱心、挚爱互发开心表情并打招呼、密友互发开心、友好互致问候、厌恶互相瞪眼。每对每天一次；玩家的伴侣会对玩家发爱心。

[font=Impact][size=5]安装指引[/size][/font]
确保电脑上已安装 SMAPI 4.0.0 或更高版本。首次进入游戏后，模组会自动生成 config.json 配置文件，可在游戏内的 Generic Mod Config Menu 菜单中随时 调整各项参数。

[size=5]主要特色[/size]
模组的核心是一套完全自主的 NPC 婚姻系统——玩家结婚后，NPC 之间也会恋爱 （通过介绍）、结婚，并举办完整的婚礼仪式。玩家还可以通过介绍信主动为 NPC 牵线搭桥，收获珍贵的谢礼。新婚夫妇会上门拜访，婚礼前有邀请函，婚后有专属 对话。此外，13 只迷你宠物会陪伴 NPC 出行，每月 14 日和冬 28 日还有两场 大型聚会。日历会标记婚礼日期，社交面板会实时更新婚姻和NPC之间好感状态，所有功能均可 在配置菜单中开关调整。

[size=5]要求[/size]
本模组需要星露谷物语 1.6 及以上版本，以及 SMAPI 4.0.0 及以上版本。需要安装Content Patcher 和 Generic Mod Config Menu，以便在游戏内修改配置。 注意：模组 MarketTown 可能导致本模组出现异常。

[size=4]致谢[/size]
感谢 DeepSeekV4、GPT3.5、Claudefable5、GLM5.2 满足了我的幻想。感谢 stardewvalleywiki 与 stardewmodding.wiki 为理解原版活动机制提供的详细 资料。感谢 ConcernedApe 创造了星露谷物语这样一个充满温暖的世界。[/center]
